comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
I just want to high-light for those who are using this aide skill. When using it in PvP, keep in mind that when this is activated... not only your opponent but you are also unable to retreat as well (double-edge sword).

This can be pretty dangerous if you get caught by disorder for instance, you've to survive at least these rounds before you can make an attempt to escape.

Principally I am doing this, because I do see several players with restriction making a mistake that they try to retreat when their aide skill is active.

I hope this helps most of you as a reminder (Lancelot mentioned it long ago).

Kind Regards,

[CA]Huseyin_Gazi
